items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: I played for Lewis during the time, uh, he threw the first ball at, uh, boys home, LaFont's home.

ctx.x: Whose band was that? George Lewis's or what? No.

That was a book. Glass. Henry Glass. It was his band. Oh, I see. And then, no, John Cashmere. Cashmere. John Cashmere. He's a pioneer in that place. It was his band. Oh, I don't understand. items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: Oh, I always admired Louis playing. Always did. Louis.

ctx.x: When you were young, did you hear some good trumpet players? Who did you like when you were a boy?
Oh, I always admired Louis playing. Always did. Louis.
When you were a boy, do you remember the parades you'd followed? Oh yeah. Who played those?
